name: Postal Address
definition: Information that locates and identifies a specific address.

StreetName.name: Street Name
StreetName.definition: Name of a street or thoroughfare.

StreetBuildingIdentification.name: Street Building Identification
StreetBuildingIdentification.definition: Number that identifies the position of a building on a street.

PostCodeIdentification.name: Post Code Identification
PostCodeIdentification.definition: Identifier consisting of a group of letters and/or numbers that is added to a postal address to assist the sorting of mail.

TownName.name: Town Name
TownName.definition: Name of a built-up area, with defined boundaries, and a local government.

BuildingName.name: Building Name
BuildingName.definition: Name of the building or house.

Floor.name: Floor
Floor.definition: Floor or storey within a building.

PostOfficeBox.name: Post Office Box
PostOfficeBox.definition: Numbered box in a post office, assigned to a person or organisation, where letters are kept until called for.

Department.name: Department
Department.definition: Identification of a division of a large organisation or building.

SubDepartment.name: Sub Department
SubDepartment.definition: Identification of a sub-division of a large organisation or building.

SuiteIdentification.name: Suite Identification
SuiteIdentification.definition: Identification of a suite or apartment.

BuildingIdentification.name: Building Identification
BuildingIdentification.definition: Identification of a building, within a group of buildings, that have the same street number identifier.

MailDeliverySubLocation.name: Mail Delivery Sub Location
MailDeliverySubLocation.definition: Specific place to deliver mail within a pre-defined postal address.

Block.name: Block
Block.definition: Area of land bounded by streets.

Lot.name: Lot
Lot.definition: Identification of an allotment of land.

UnitNumber.name: Unit Number
UnitNumber.definition: Identifies a flat or dwelling within the building.

ChequeIssue.name: Cheque Issue
ChequeIssue.definition: Cheque issue information for which a delivery address is specified.

ValidityPeriod.name: Validity Period
ValidityPeriod.definition: Specifies the period during which a postal address is valid.

MailingInstructions.name: Mailing Instructions
MailingInstructions.definition: Specifies the characteristics of an address.

PhysicalDelivery.name: Physical Delivery
PhysicalDelivery.definition: Physical delivery information related to an address.

CareOf.name: Care Of
CareOf.definition: Identifies an addressee that is accepting the correspondence for the intended recipient. Using care of ensures the correspondence reaches the right recipient rather than getting returned to the sender.
